info.name: Microsoft Windows 10 Windows Background Tasks Accelerometer Controls API

items.docs: Retrieves the catalog of available WinUI XAML controls organized by category. Includes basic input controls (Button, TextBox, CheckBox), collections (ListView, GridView, TreeView), navigation (NavigationView, TabView, Pivot), status (ProgressBar, ProgressRing, InfoBar), and media controls (MediaPlayerElement, Image).
Retrieves detailed information about a specific WinUI control including its properties, events, methods, XAML usage examples, and Fluent Design System guidelines.
